item.title: Donald Trump calls himself acting president as Venezuelan oil heads to US
item.description: US President Donald Trump has escalated Washington’s involvement in Venezuela, claiming authority over the country’s oil revenues held abroad and portraying the situation as “working out well” following the removal of long-time leader Nicolás Maduro.

item.title: Trump signals strong response as Iran protests enter a third week
item.description: US President Donald Trump has said Washington is considering “very strong options”, including possible military intervention, in response to the escalating protests in Iran, even as he claimed Tehran’s leadership had reached out to seek negotiations.

item.title: Israel watches Iran protests warily amid fears of wider regional escalation
item.description: Israel is closely monitoring the fallout from widespread protests in Iran, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu says, as US President Donald Trump’s threats of military action raise fears the unrest could escalate into a wider regional conflict.

item.title: Sensex, Nifty open sharply lower as foreign outflows and tariff fears weigh on sentiment
item.description: Indian equity markets opened sharply lower on Monday as persistent foreign fund outflows, worries over possible US tariffs on Indian exports and broader geopolitical tensions dented investor confidence.

item.title: Opposition flags economic concerns as Parliament schedule is announced
item.description: The schedule for the forthcoming session of Parliament has been announced, with the Union Budget for 2026/27 set to be presented in about three weeks, drawing early political focus to the state of the economy and Centre–state finances.
